tasks.title: HANGS General Contracting · FY2026 Loan Covenant Procedures
tasks.description: Perform the nine agreed-upon procedures Ferncastle Bank and HANGS General Contracting LP agreed for the bank's FY2026 covenant check, from 9 PDF, Excel and email files: the engagement letter, the loan agreement's definitions and covenants, the trial balance and statements, the debt schedule, the fixed asset register, the retainage aging, the compliance certificate and the bank's receipt. Recompute every covenant from the source figures as the agreement defines it, compare it with its level, and report what was found without an opinion. Produce formula-linked workpapers with tickmarks and a draft agreed-upon procedures report. The engagement partner reviews, signs and dates it.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with tickmarks and evidence tabs, and a draft agreed-upon procedures report PDF with evidence trails and the original files attached
tasks.outputsPath: Outputs/HANGS General Contracting FY2026 Covenant Procedures
tasks.gates: Draft report, not reviewed, signed, dated or sent. Findings only: no opinion or conclusion. Open items stay open. The engagement partner signs.
tasks.periodLine: FY2026: as of and for the year ended June 30, 2026 · loan covenant agreed-upon procedures for the lender.
